drive.title: Copy backups to Google Drive
drive.found: Google Drive for desktop is on this computer. Choose its folder and every backup is also copied to your Google Drive.
drive.inUse: Backups go to this Google Drive folder.
drive.streamWarn: Tula runs before anyone signs in and cannot see a Google Drive drive letter. In Google Drive's Preferences choose "Mirror files", then come back and use the folder under C:\Users\<name>\My Drive.
drive.notRunning: Google Drive is not running on this computer now. Backups still go into the folder and are copied to the cloud once Google Drive runs again.
drive.notFound: Google Drive for desktop was not found on this computer.
drive.how1: Install Google Drive for desktop (google.com/drive/download) and sign in with the shop's Google account.
drive.how2: In Google Drive: gear icon → Preferences → Google Drive → Mirror files.
drive.how3: Open this screen again: the folder appears here. Choose it, then press Back up now.
drive.how4: Check on drive.google.com that the backup arrives within a few minutes.
drive.saved: Backup folder set to {{folder}}. Press Back up now to try it.
